component.name: Facet
component.summary: A light 3D model viewer with precise measuring

description.p: Facet opens 3D models quickly and keeps out of the way. It suits a sculpted figure you just want to turn around, and a technical part whose sizes you need exactly.

ul.li: Opens STL (binary and text), OBJ, PLY and 3MF, with the colours they carry
Turn, move and zoom; standard views; perspective or flat (orthographic) view
Solid, outlined-edges and wireframe display, smooth or faceted shading
Exact measuring: distances with X/Y/Z parts, angles, and the diameter of a hole, with snapping to corners and edges
Size of the model, volume, surface area, centre of mass and weight in common materials, in mm, cm, m or inches
A section plane to look inside a part, and a mesh check for holes and flipped faces before printing
Save or copy a picture of the view

description.p: Fixed the interface size not changing after a restart.
The interface now has the same size as the other apps.
First release: opens STL, OBJ, PLY and 3MF models, with exact distance, angle and hole measuring, a section plane, a mesh check, and a high-contrast, large-text interface.
